body.text: Today's audit meeting has moved to 14.00 in meeting room 2. The meeting papers will be handed out there.

explanation: This email comes from the real office domain, has no link, and does not ask for a login or any data. A schedule update like this is legit, even on a day full of attacks.
hints: Compare this sender's domain with the earlier audit email.
Is there a link, an attachment, or a request for data?
